chips.text: Saskatoon Land needs name 24 months in advance for branding and marketing.
Councillor asked if "Hawthorn" has Cree meaning and about Indigenous consultation.
Councillor expressed discomfort with name due to lack of community argument and process.
Administration developing interim approach for future naming requests and new policy by spring.

segments.title: Administration Presents Proposed Neighborhood Name
segments.takeaway: Administration introduces "Hawthorn" as the proposed name for the University Heights 3 neighborhood, explaining its alignment with current policy and the new place identity framework.

segments.title: Committee Questions on Naming Process and Urgency
segments.takeaway: Committee members question Saskatoon Land and administration about the necessity of naming the neighborhood early and the process for engaging stakeholders under the new framework.

segments.title: Committee Expresses Concerns on Engagement and Framework Alignment
segments.takeaway: Committee members voice discomfort with proceeding without clearer community engagement and express concerns about the proposed name not fully aligning with the new place identity framework.

segments.title: Motion to Defer Decision for Targeted Engagement
segments.takeaway: A motion is made to defer the decision on the "Hawthorn" name to allow Saskatoon Land and administration to conduct targeted engagement with relevant groups.

segments.title: Confirmation of Deferral and Next Steps
segments.takeaway: The committee confirms the deferral of the decision to the March 5th meeting, where a report on the targeted engagement will be presented for further consideration.

description: City staff member Nick Kinsel leaves Naming Committee.
Administration is planning for his replacement and committee work.

chips.text: Councillor Davis questioned if committee members would be involved in future planning.
Staff clarified that administration decisions are separate from committee policy oversight.
Will Naming Committee members be included in the report's initial engagement phase?
